title: Conditional κ = 0.00315087 (+3.0e-7 over #6353)
body:
This changes two PR6353 helper outputs from rank nine to rank eight and replaces two paid rank-five transports with rank-four transports. The complete conditional claim rises from **κ = 0.00315057 to 0.00315087**, a gain of **0.00000030 (0.00952%)**. The fixed PR6348 caller and all 770 independent public inputs are preserved.

A joint input and departure basis changes a contact block excluded from the earlier search. The exact per-call changes are `paid: 2H4 − 2H5` and `productive: 2H8 − 2H9`. Their signed gain is positive for every strictly concave power tariff. All 19 calls, both new owned lifetimes and ordinary operations are charged. The complete rational crossing lies in `(0.00315087900390, 0.00315087900391)`.

Evidence:

- Exact basis and full-word replay; all 799 scalar columns and separate reverse coefficients.
- All 2,933 native maps with absolute phases, 7,904 physical caller contacts, both rational price engines, completion/compiler checks, and 54 strict plus four functional outer predicates.
- Registered normal and optimized replays; sealed Git-free, read-only export replays; 32 explicit rejection controls and eight actual-file corruption checks.
- Committed bytes, executable modes and all 15 declared inputs checked.

Reproduce with Python 3.12:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-contact-block-contraction
```

Sources: canonical main `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, PR6353 `db2a20bc50bc7a8a4db931af85ce7f012ae7c3c3`, and the unchanged PR6348 caller. The retained source copies have exact Git/SHA256 pins in this branch's ancestry. [Proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b556600ffe14be72406b03a47c661f3c7f1aff06/research/p104-contact-block-contraction/PROOF.md), [exact result](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b556600ffe14be72406b03a47c661f3c7f1aff06/research/p104-contact-block-contraction/RESULT.json), and [validation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b556600ffe14be72406b03a47c661f3c7f1aff06/research/p104-contact-block-contraction/VALIDATION.md). [Hosted planning and the complete registered replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41467915997) pass at publication head `b556600ffe14be72406b03a47c661f3c7f1aff06`, including the unchanged-input check.

All five framework assumptions remain. The uniform word and rounded multiplier are not materialized. This is author-checked evidence, not independent scientific acceptance or a selected-frontier change. Open questions identify the exact pairings, zero rows and signed bill for independent review.

Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. No subagents. Apache-2.0. PR6353, PR6349, PR6348, DreamingOfClouds, Cinna Davis and all predecessor native/helper/caller/compiler authors retain their credit in NOTICE.
